description: This file defines a class 'ADODB2_generic' extending 'ADODB_DataDict' which provides methods for data type mapping and SQL alterations in a database abstraction layer context, specifically for a generic database type. It includes support for customizing types, converting abstract metadata to actual database types, and includes unimplemented methods for altering and dropping columns.

classes.name: ADODB2_generic
classes.description: A class providing database abstraction and type mapping for a generic database system within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts a meta type code to an actual database type string, with support for custom meta types.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Placeholder method for generating SQL to alter columns; currently not supported.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Placeholder method for generating SQL to drop columns; currently not supported.
